ideas.pitch: Automated video clipping and localized meme generator that turns Bhaktiwala's long-form katha streams into viral short-form clips embedded with custom referral QR codes.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides high retention and daily active usage, ensuring that installed users actually run the required features to count as verified installs instead of just churning.

ideas.pitch: A real-time marketing analytics dashboard tracking conversion funnels, click-through rates on social media campaigns, and predictive user acquisition cost for the Bhaktiwala referral drive.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in a growth and marketing challenge will reward data-driven execution; this tool proves strategic depth beyond just spamming referral links.
